notes: Iteration 0 catalog for Ollama on Windows. Pull the models first: `ollama pull qwen2.5:0.5b-instruct` and `ollama pull qwen2.5:1.5b-instruct`. servedModel must match the tag `ollama list` shows. Ollama serves an OpenAI-compatible API at http://localhost:11434/v1 (its docs) and ignores the API key. COLD START: Ollama sends no response headers until a model is resident, so an unloaded model looks like a hung upstream and the first request can exceed --attempt-timeout-ms and fail over (measured >120s on a cold 0.5B, <0.5s warm). No healthUrl is set because Ollama has no per-model readiness endpoint: /v1/models answers 200 whether or not anything is loaded, so the pool reads healthy during a cold-start stall. Set OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=-1 to keep models resident; see README "Cold start". Pricing values are RELATIVE PLACEHOLDERS proportional to parameter count, not measured cost.
